# Vercel: delete an edge config

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To delete an edge config in Vercel, call the DELETE /v1/edge-configs/:id endpoint with SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the exact endpoint path, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for required authentication headers, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the expected success status code. The response returns SOURCE FACT REQUIRED for the response shape.

Search intents:
- Vercel delete edge config
- Vercel edge config deletion API

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/vercel-delete-edge-config --json
